parameters.query:
SELECT i.*,   
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = i.currency THEN p.amount ELSE p.converted_amount END), 0) FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id = i.id) as paid_amount, o.doc_no AS order_doc_no
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE i.id = $1

SELECT u.name, u.email
FROM users u
WHERE u.id = $1

parameters.query:
SELECT i.id, i.status, i.payment_state
FROM invoices i
WHERE i.id = $1

SELECT q.id, q.payment_status, q.total
FROM quotes q
JOIN orders o ON o.quote_id = q.id
JOIN invoices i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE i.id = $1
